title: Right pattern, wrong place
prompt: It is 09:58 ET. Read the chart and decide.

intro.beginner: The pattern on the 5m is clean. Before you trade a pattern, look at where on the bigger chart it is, and how much room there is before the next pool of liquidity.
intro.advanced: 09:58 ET. A clean model. Where is it?

whyNot.label: buying the 5m setup
whyNot.why: Everything about the model is right and the location isn't: price is already within a few points of the previous day high. The stop has to sit under the sweep low, a long way down, while the only reward available is a few points to the high.

whyNot.label: shorting the high
whyNot.why: Nothing has swept the high or shifted structure down yet. 'Near resistance' is not a reason to sell on its own.

reference.summary: A clean sweep, displacement and gap that formed right under the previous day high. The pattern is real; the room isn't. A stop beneath the sweep and a few points of reward is a bad trade however good the entry looks.

bias.why: Higher highs and higher lows on the Daily and 4H: the trend is up, and price is at the top of the range it's been building.

decision.why: There's no room. Standing aside, or waiting for a retrace into discount or a break above the high, is the position; the entry on its own isn't the trade.

take.why: The model is valid and the location isn't.

draw.why: The previous day high is the draw, and price is nearly there already.

location.why: Price is in the premium of yesterday's range, right at the top.

annotations.label: Previous day high 23,268
annotations.why: The pool above and the problem: price is already beside it, so a long has almost no reward while risking a full stop below the sweep.
annotations.decisionNote: Reward is the distance to the draw. Here it's a few points against a risk of dozens.

annotations.label: 5m bullish FVG from the displacement
annotations.why: A clean entry model with nowhere to go. It's valid as a pattern and wrong as a trade.
annotations.whyNot: A good entry doesn't make a good trade. Location and room come first.

annotations.label: Sweep low 23,182
annotations.why: Real, and it sets a stop that's too far from the entry for the room on offer.

confluences.label: Price is just under the previous day high
Price is at the top of the Daily range

confluences.why: Real, and small in the context of how high price already is.

confluences.label: Displacement with an FVG
confluences.why: A textbook entry into no reward.

confluences.label: Daily and 4H trending up
confluences.why: The trend is a reason to wait for discount, not to buy the top.

lookFor: Measure the room to the draw before you measure the entry. Reward has to beat risk by a margin.
Premium is where longs are weakest, even in an uptrend. Wait for discount.
A clean pattern is only one ingredient. Location is the other.
